description: An experimental cowbell voice built from spread oscillators, a band filter, distortion and an internal envelope

params.text: Sets the base frequency the oscillators are tuned around
Sets how far the other oscillators are tuned away from the base frequency
Sets how long the strike rings out, up to 5 seconds
Sets the centre frequency of the filter
Sets the width of the filter band
Sets the amount of distortion applied
Clears the audio buffer, which stops the feedback that some settings can build up

inputs.text: Modulates the spread of the oscillators
Modulates how long the strike rings out
Modulates the centre frequency of the filter
Modulates the width of the filter band

notes: every CV input is calibrated to -5 to +5V and is added to its knob, with the result clamped to the range of that knob
the voice sounds only when it is struck, by the Hit! button or a trigger at the hit input
